api._comment: Xyro API - the Cloudflare Worker in api/ (see api/README.md). Clients route the staff list, the command queue, presence and the kill switch through it, so the database credential stays server-side and the database rules can stay closed to the public. An empty url keeps the direct Firebase behaviour - set it back to "" to roll everything back to the database. This key is PUBLIC by design: it only reads and heartbeats. The owner key (XYRO_ADMIN_KEY) is what writes the blacklist and trips the kill switch, and it never goes in the repo.
